 Miami is a road favorite against the struggling Clippers on Wednesday. Peter Dewey | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo is a great prop target on Nov. 4. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Los Angeles Clippers Miami Heat Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Miami Heat are off to a slow start in the 2026-27 season, winning just two of their first seven games while ranking 21st in the league in net rating and 27th in defensive rating.
--> Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Miami Heat are off to a slow start in the 2026-27 season, winning just two of their first seven games while ranking 21st in the league in net rating and 27th in defensive rating.
 The Heat may need another transaction cycle to truly fit this roster around the two-time league MVP, but it has to make due for now in a loaded Eastern Conference.
--> The Heat may need another transaction cycle to truly fit this roster around the two-time league MVP, but it has to make due for now in a loaded Eastern Conference.
 After losing to the Los Angeles Lakers on Monday, the Heat remain in L.A. to face Darius Garland and the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday.
--> After losing to the Los Angeles Lakers on Monday, the Heat remain in L.A. to face Darius Garland and the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday.
 The offseason was one to forget for the Clips, who lost five first-round picks in the Kawhi Leonard cap circumvention scandal, and they’re already down several rotation players due to injury (Brandon Ingram, Bradley, Beal, Jordan Miller and more) to open this season. 
--> The offseason was one to forget for the Clips, who lost five first-round picks in the Kawhi Leonard cap circumvention scandal, and they’re already down several rotation players due to injury (Brandon Ingram, Bradley, Beal, Jordan Miller and more) to open this season. 
 As a result, the Clips are just 1-6, losing six games in a row after winning their season opener against Sacramento. They’re set as 4.5-point underdogs on their home floor on Wednesday.
--> As a result, the Clips are just 1-6, losing six games in a row after winning their season opener against Sacramento. They’re set as 4.5-point underdogs on their home floor on Wednesday.
 This is a prime spot for Miami to get a win, and it needs every one it can get with the East featuring several viable playoff contenders in the Southeast Division. 
--> This is a prime spot for Miami to get a win, and it needs every one it can get with the East featuring several viable playoff contenders in the Southeast Division.

 Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo has 12 or more rebounds in five of his seven games this season, averaging 19.7 rebound chances per game. 
--> Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo has 12 or more rebounds in five of his seven games this season, averaging 19.7 rebound chances per game. 
 Antetokounmpo should be able to clear this line again on Wednesday against a Los Angeles Clippers team that is just 14th in the league in rebound percentage and remains without young center Yanic Konan Niederhauser.  
--> Antetokounmpo should be able to clear this line again on Wednesday against a Los Angeles Clippers team that is just 14th in the league in rebound percentage and remains without young center Yanic Konan Niederhauser.  
 The Clips have missed a ton of shots, ranking 24th in points per game this season, and Miami is going to push the pace in this game (fourth in the NBA) which should lead to a few extra possessions on both sides.  
--> The Clips have missed a ton of shots, ranking 24th in points per game this season, and Miami is going to push the pace in this game (fourth in the NBA) which should lead to a few extra possessions on both sides.  
 Giannis has done it all for the Heat in the 2026-27 campaign, and he should remain the team’s leading rebounder on Wednesday.  
--> Giannis has done it all for the Heat in the 2026-27 campaign, and he should remain the team’s leading rebounder on Wednesday.  
 Heat vs. Clippers Prediction and Pick 
--> Heat vs. Clippers Prediction and Pick 
 Miami has not gotten off to a strong start this season, struggling mightily on the defensive end of the floor. Luckily, the Clippers’ offense has been one of the worst in the league. 
--> Miami has not gotten off to a strong start this season, struggling mightily on the defensive end of the floor. Luckily, the Clippers’ offense has been one of the worst in the league. 
 L.A.’s only win came against the Sacramento Kings, and it doesn’t deserve to be this small of an underdog against a Heat team that still has Giannis Antetokounmpo.  
--> L.A.’s only win came against the Sacramento Kings, and it doesn’t deserve to be this small of an underdog against a Heat team that still has Giannis Antetokounmpo.  
 Miami has played better after starting the season 0-4, and it ranks 12th in the league in offensive rating despite the slow start. 
--> Miami has played better after starting the season 0-4, and it ranks 12th in the league in offensive rating despite the slow start. 
 I think the Clippers’ lack of frontcourt depth and their total lack of proven scoring after Darius Garland is too much to overcome in this matchup. The Clips seem destined for a bottom-three record in the West this season. 
--> I think the Clippers’ lack of frontcourt depth and their total lack of proven scoring after Darius Garland is too much to overcome in this matchup. The Clips seem destined for a bottom-three record in the West this season.
